note: Voice variety from three drone + staff pairs, one per block, each in a new key and scale: a short leap drill in major, then made-up calls and answers in minor, then a free tune in Mixolydian. Each staff shows only the notes in play; only the first block is a bare drill.

exercise.title: 4ths and 5ths in three scales
exercise.focus: Leaps of a 4th and 5th over a drone · F major · D minor · G Mixolydian
exercise.why: A leap lands in tune once you hear the landing note first, so practise landings over a drone.

sections.text: Press Play on the drone. Start the mic on the staff to see your pitch. Sing {{1}} up to {{4}}, then {{1}} up to {{5}}. Hear the landing note in your head before you sing it.
Press Play on the drone on D. The same leaps now sit in D minor, with {{b3}} added. Sing a short call that leaps from {{1}}. Answer it with a different leap that ends on {{1}}.
Press Play on the drone on G. Make up a short tune from {{1}}, {{4}}, {{5}} with {{b7}}, leaping between them in any order. Watch your pitch line land on each note.
